Helper Methods
format_message
function format_message(
p_message 
in message_type
)
return clob

Method to convert a message_type message into a clob.  Conventions used: Notification messages have three reserved message args:

1

Room, defines the room the message is assigned to

2

Event, defines the event that caused the message to be sent

3

action, optional definition of a method that is to be executed client side to handle the message

Normal message args have to be passed as argument 4

50.
